main.description: An account's hidden profile, for a viewer in one of its listed audiences. Served by the viewer's serving app at its #umbrae_app endpoint, with atproto service auth (iss the viewer, aud the serving app, lxm this method); clients call through their PDS with atproto-proxy set to that app. The app answers only for profiles whose owner delegates to it, and never returns the audience list to anyone but the owner.

profile.description: The tools.umbrae.profile record value, with its blob refs, without audiences (unless the viewer is the owner). Fetch its blobs with tools.umbrae.actor.getProfileBlob.

errors.name: ProfileNotFound
errors.description: No profile, not one the viewer may see, or not one this app holds. The same answer for all three.
